text_en: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and settle there. Make an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau. ”
text_cn: 天主对雅各伯说：“起来，上贝特耳去，住在那里，为你昔日逃避你哥哥厄撒乌在那里显现给你的天主，筑一祭坛。”

text_en: So Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, and purify yourselves, and change your clothes;
text_cn: 雅各伯便对家人和跟随他的人说：“你们应除去你们中间所有外邦的神像，并取洁，更换衣服，

text_en: then come, let us go up to Bethel, that I may make an altar there to the God who answered me in the day of my distress and has been with me wherever I have gone. ”
text_cn: 因为我们要起身上贝特耳去；在那里我要给在我困苦的时日俯听了我，在我所走的路上伴随了我的天主，筑一祭坛。”

text_en: So they gave to Jacob all the foreign gods that they had, and the rings that were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak that was near Shechem.
text_cn: 众人便将自己手中所有外邦的神像，所有的耳环，都交给了雅各伯；雅各伯就都埋在那靠近舍根的橡树底下。

text_en: As they journeyed, a terror from God fell upon the cities all around them, so that no one pursued them.
text_cn: 当他们起程出发时，天主叫周围的城邑都非常恐怖，为此谁也不敢追赶雅各伯的儿子。

text_en: Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him,
text_cn: 这样，雅各伯和与他在一起的人，来到客纳罕地的路次，即贝特耳；

text_en: and there he built an altar and called the place El-bethel, because it was there that God had revealed himself to him when he fled from his brother.
text_cn: 他在那里筑了一座祭坛。称呼那地方为贝特耳，因为他逃避他哥哥时，天主曾在那里显现给他。

text_en: And Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried under an oak below Bethel. So it was called Allon-bacuth.
text_cn: 其时黎贝加的乳母德波辣死了，就埋在贝特耳下面的一株橡树底下；为此给这橡树起名叫“悲泣的橡树”。

text_en: God appeared to Jacob again when he came from Paddan-aram, and he blessed him.
text_cn: 雅各伯由帕丹阿兰回来后，天主又显现给他，再祝福他。

text_en: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob; no longer shall you be called Jacob, but Israel shall be your name. ” So he was called Israel.
text_cn: 天主对他说：“你原叫雅各伯，但以后不再叫作雅各伯，却要叫作以色列。”遂给他改名以色列。

text_en: God said to him, “I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall come from you, and kings shall spring from you.
text_cn: 天主又对他说：“我是全能的天主，你要生育繁殖；不但一个民族，而是一些民族要由你而生，许多君王要由你而生。

text_en: The land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac I will give to you, and I will give the land to your offspring after you. ”
text_cn: 我将赐给了亚巴郎和依撒格的土地赐给你；我也将这土地赐给你未来的后裔。”

text_en: Then God went up from him at the place where he had spoken with him.
text_cn: 然后天主就在与他谈话的地方，离开他，上升去了。

text_en: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he had spoken with him, a pillar of stone; and he poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.
text_cn: 雅各伯在天主与他谈话地方，竖立了一根柱子，一根石柱；在上面行了奠祭，倒上油。

text_en: So Jacob called the place where God had spoken with him Bethel.
text_cn: 雅各伯给天主与他谈话的地方起名叫贝特耳。

text_en: Then they journeyed from Bethel; and when they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel was in childbirth, and she had hard labor.
text_cn: 他们由贝特耳起程出发，离厄弗辣大还有一段路程时，辣黑耳要生产，感觉难产。

text_en: When she was in her hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Do not be afraid; for now you will have another son. ”
text_cn: 正当难产之际，收生婆对她说：“不要怕，你这次还是生个男孩。”

text_en: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Ben-oni; but his father called him Benjamin.
text_cn: 辣黑耳将要断气快死的时候，给他起名叫本敖尼；但他的父亲却叫他本雅明。

text_en: So Rachel died, and she was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem),
text_cn: 辣黑耳死了，葬在去厄弗辣大，即白冷的路旁。

text_en: and Jacob set up a pillar at her grave; it is the pillar of Rachel’s tomb, which is there to this day.
text_cn: 雅各伯在她坟上立了一块碑；这块辣黑耳坟上的碑，至今尚存。

text_en: Israel journeyed on, and pitched his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
text_cn: 以色列又起程前行，在米革达耳厄德尔的那一面支搭了帐幕。

text_en: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine; and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.
text_cn: 以色列住在那地时，勒乌本竟去与他父亲的妾彼耳哈同睡；以色列后来闻知了此事。 雅各伯的儿子共计十二人。

text_en: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
text_cn: 肋阿的儿子：雅各伯的长子勒乌本、西默盎、肋未、犹大、依撒加尔和则步隆。

text_en: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
text_cn: 辣黑耳的儿子：若瑟和本雅明。

text_en: The sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s maid: Dan and Naphtali.
text_cn: 辣黑耳的婢女彼耳哈的儿子：丹和纳斐塔里。

text_en: The sons of Zilpah, Leah’s maid: Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Paddan-aram.
text_cn: 肋阿的婢女齐耳帕的儿子：加得和阿协尔：这些都是雅各伯在帕丹阿兰生的儿子。

text_en: Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre, or Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had resided as aliens.
text_cn: 雅各伯来到了克黎雅特阿尔巴，即赫贝龙的玛默勒他父亲依撒格那里，即亚巴郎和依撒格曾寄居过的地方。

text_en: Now the days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.
text_cn: 依撒格享寿一百八十岁。

text_en: And Isaac breathed his last; he died and was gathered to his people, old and full of days; and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
text_cn: 他年高老迈，已享天年，遂断气而死，归到他亲族那里去了；他的儿子厄撒乌和雅各伯将他埋葬了。
